notes: Batch-exports every dataset in a libref to Excel: PROC SQL reads memname from sashelp.vtable into &data_lst, then the %re_ad macro loops and PROC EXPORT (dbms=excel) each one. Kept the SQL enumeration and %re_ad macro verbatim. Substituted the external libname pad (original pointed at a local Windows path) with two small sashelp-derived sample datasets, and rewrote the hardcoded absolute outfile path to a relative ./&dsnm..xlsx. Runs ok, exit_code 0, produces CARS.xlsx and CLASS.xlsx.
